name: HiMERU
source:
HiMERU was a solo idol in the past. He speaks in a manner that distances him from the others. HiMERU is a mysterious person with gentle and collective behaviors. Sometimes he acts like confirming his behaviors to himself. HiMERU sings with am enchanting voice, accompanied by mature and seductive performances that exceed his age.

HiMERU is a member of Crazy:B at COSMIC PRODUCTION.

[From in-game profile]
